messages:
Ethan Park: hey team, quick onboarding snag — Kandji shows 'Installing profiles' forever when I'm plugged into the USB-C dock. Switch to wifi and it finishes. macOS 14.5. Any tips?

Lena (IT): welcome Ethan :wave: do you see any error text? did you use the dock during first boot?

Ethan Park: just the spinner and 'Installing profiles'. yes docked at my desk for OOBE. unplugging finishes enrollment.

Kandji-bot: Enrollment attempt recorded for "Ethan Park - MacBookPro16" at 2026-10-12T09:04:04Z. Applied policy: "New Hire - MacOS".

Jordan (Device Admin): common pattern: some docks delay network initialization or create a virtual interface that confuses the enrollment agent. Kandji needs immediate HTTPS to our endpoints to escrow FV keys and apply scripts. Workarounds: 1) unplug dock, finish enrollment over wifi, then replug. 2) if you'd rather keep docked, open Terminal and run `sudo networksetup -setnetworkserviceenabled "Wi-Fi" on` then ensure Wi-Fi is preferred in System Settings > Network order before continuing.

NetOps: noted — docked ports can be on a slow provisioning VLAN. We can add a DHCP exception for serial or MAC to allow early access if you want; ping me the serial and we'll queue it.

Ethan Park: i finished via wifi and FileVault prompt showed up. Replugged dock after and everything stayed good. Serial is C02EPK123456.

Lena (IT): great. Jordan, can you add a one-liner to the New Hire checklist about docks + enrollment? I'll mark this as resolved for Ethan.

Jordan (Device Admin): adding KB note now: "If enrollment stalls when docked, unplug and enroll on wifi, or enable Wi‑Fi and prefer it in network service order. NetOps can add DHCP onboarding exceptions for problem docks."

Helpdesk Bot: Ticket #INC-2026-902 opened (NetOps) for DHCP onboarding exception request (serial C02EPK123456).

Ethan Park: thanks all! saved me some head-scratching :sweat_smile:
